field: Valkey cache side effect and freshness
legacy_behavior: Reads the in-memory OptionMap under its read lock and does not create a Valkey key.
rust_behavior: Cache-aside read creates lmm:public-content:v1:notice on a miss with a configured 1..5 second TTL; PostgreSQL options remains authoritative and cache failures fall back to PostgreSQL.
rationale: A bounded non-authoritative cache changes latency and temporary freshness only, while retaining the frozen response and durable-read contract; independent approval is not complete.
